special_note: The last time Topps issued cards in series format, resulting in scarce high-number cards.
description_block: The '73 Topps issue is significant in that was the last time that Topps issued cards in series format, a practice that resulted in scarce high-number cards over the years. Also, the card stock used for the series was of noticeably poorer quality than in previous years, making for damage-prone corners and edges. Coupled with the black-bordered reverses, as well as notorious centering and print problems, it's easy to see why the set is so difficult to obtain in NM or better condition. The offered complete set grades approximately 10% NM/MT, 25% NM, and 25% EX/MT, 20% EX, 20% lesser.
